The formal-authority claim survives this bounded provenance challenge. Fourteen replay receipts match the source manifest and report stable source with exit zero; the audit output contains 66 root records. The manuscript correctly retains the inherited-object trust boundary. Canonical snapshot and manuscript hashes match. No clean dependency rebuild or independent reproduction was performed in this review.

The inherited degree cap is correctly attributed and applied. Its actual hypotheses match the 28-member intersecting rank-four sunflower-free families used here, without requiring I(27) or either boundary exclusion. No source-mapping repair is required for this input. I verified the fresh snapshot and manuscript hashes and manifest hashes of all four inspected Lean modules.

The source-relative contribution is accurately attributed. The inherited capacity and the conditional unrestricted bound are distinct results, and the manuscript keeps their unresolved inputs explicit. I verified the frozen manuscript and canonical snapshot hashes and the manifest hashes of both inspected A1K modules. No attribution revision is required from this focused check.
